Job.JobTitle: Senior Workday Integration Developer (Workday Studio, EIB, REST/SOAP, HCM & Finance)
Job.JobDescription:
Seeking a highly skilled Workday Integration Developer (official NJM job title) to design, develop, enhance, and support integrations between Workday and enterprise applications.


This role is responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and reliable integration solutions using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP), and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS). The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise within the Workday ecosystem, a strong understanding of Workday security and tenant management, and a proven track record of implementing enterprise-grade integrations in complex environments.


The successful candidate will partner closely with IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring integration performance, data integrity, compliance, and operational stability. This role also serves as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on integration architecture, development standards, testing strategies, and Workday best practices.


Job Responsibilities:


Integration Design & Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations utilizing:
    • Workday Studio
    • Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
    • Core Connectors
    • Cloud Connect
    • PECI
    • Workday Web Services (REST and SOAP APIs)
  • Develop inbound and outbound integrations between Workday and external systems, including payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Create and maintain XSLT transformations, XML schemas, and integration mappings to support complex business requirements.
  • Design scalable integration architectures that follow Workday and enterprise integration best practices.
  • Develop and maintain reusable integration components and standards to improve supportability and efficiency.

Workday Configuration & Security

  • Configure and maintain Integration System Users (ISUs), Integration System Security Groups (ISSGs), domain security policies, and related security configurations.
  • Build and maintain custom reports, calculated fields, and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS) solutions supporting integration and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with functional teams to align business process configurations, approvals, and event triggers with integration requirements.

Production Support & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues across production and non-production environments.
  • Develop robust error handling, auditing, alerting, and recovery processes to ensure reliable operations.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, migrations, and release activities, including impact assessments and regression testing.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet organizational standards for security, compliance, performance, and data governance.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with HCM, Finance, IT, and external vendors to define requirements and deliver effective integration solutions.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and provide recommendations for improving integration of architecture and operational processes.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote Workday integration development best practices.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including design specifications, support procedures, configuration details, and data flow diagrams.
  • Stay current with Workday releases, emerging technologies, and integration capabilities to drive continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of Workday Integration development experience.
  • Advanced experience developing integrations using:
    • Workday Studio
    • EIB
    • Core Connectors
    • Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP)
       
  • Strong expertise with XSLT, XML, XPath, and integration design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of Workday HCM, Financial Management, and security architecture.
  • Experience configuring and supporting ISUs, ISSGs, and Workday security frameworks.
  • Experience building calculated fields, custom reports, and RaaS integrations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting Workday production environments and release management activities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Workday Pro Integrations Certification.
  • Experience with PECI, or other payroll-focused integrations.
  • Experience with Workday Orchestrate.
  • Experience integrating Workday with payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms.
  • Experience supporting Workday deployments.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and data privacy requirements related to HCM and Finance systems.

Key Competencies:

  • Workday Integration Architecture
  • Workday Studio Development
  • EIB and Core Connector Configuration
  • REST and SOAP API Development
  • XSLT/XML Transformation Design
  • Workday Security Administration
  • Report Writing and Calculated Fields
  • Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Technical Documentation
  • Release and Tenant Management
  • Continuous Improvement and Best Practices

General Summary: 

Do you have a strong network with property and casualty insurance brokers in the greater Maryland / Delaware area? Do you have prior experience in Commercial Lines Sales, Commercial Lines Production Underwriting, or as a Broker Relationship Manager in Commercial Lines? If so, this is the perfect opportunity for you! This position offers a generous base of $90,000 to $135,000 (commensurate with relevant experience) with a quarterly and annual incentive opportunity that has the potential to add a significant amount to your total compensation annually. You are also eligible for our incredible benefits package, which includes a 401k with a dollar for dollar match up to 8% with immediate vesting and an additional employer contribution after the first year that grows to an additional 6% over 15 years of service!

NJM Insurance Group, a leading mid-Atlantic property casualty carrier, seeks to expand distribution partner relationships, new business, and products in Maryland and Delaware. As part of that expansion, we are seeking an experienced Distribution Representative in Commercial Lines. This Distribution Representative will be based in the greater Maryland market (southern Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred), so that they can work closely with existing and new distribution partners to secure new business for the organization.


Distribution Representatives meet regularly with agency/brokerage distribution partners in pursuit of additional business in the small, mid and large-size markets. The right candidate would already possess key commercial agency/brokerage relationships, presence and credibility in the Maryland / Delaware territory. These relationships will specifically be utilized to appoint and grow our distribution partner network in the region consistent with NJM’s exclusive distribution model.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Match existing Maryland / Delaware agent relationships and books of business opportunities with those of NJM
  • Based on this analysis recommend for appointment new commercial lines distribution partners in the territory. Ultimately through the review process sign up all appropriate agents based on the strength of these current relationships
  • Pursue, upsell, cross-sell, recapture opportunities with agencies/brokers
  • Coordinate New Business Proposal Meetings on key accounts to agencies and brokers; present NJM optional plans

The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.

To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours:

Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time).

Training is required at the NJM- West Trenton office.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in Western and/or Central PA or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in Western and/or Central PA. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for PA, MD and/or DE claims.

  • Knowledge of and/or experience working with liens and Medicare Set-Asides to secure full and final settlements

  • Customer service oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work both in a team and independently

  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and use of sound decision-making capabilities

  • Working knowledge utilizing an automated claim processing system and Microsoft Office tools including Word and Outlook

  • Licensed in DE and/or CT to adjust WC claims or have the ability to obtain these licenses within 90 days.

  • Ability to travel for business purposes, approximately 2 – 3 days a week meeting with policyholders and/or agents

  • AIC/CPCU or other applicable insurance designations

  • Experience using Guidewire Claim Center, OnBase and additional Microsoft Office tools including Teams, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge and experience in claims handling for other commercial line products in various states including PA, MD and/or DE.
